author: KevineCove
body:
Probably the lower tier characters have good armor. Again, my suggestion is to use poison if everything else fails. The best weapons I know of for them are as follows:

T3 - Dudley's Hammer 

T5 - Reinbow

T7 - Fey Badb Warbow

T9 - Brilliant Feathers

A good quality and fully leveled version of these should punch through almost any character's defenses.

author: KevineCove
body:
Who are you fighting? The NPCs you fight have low stats and you should be putting up damage against them, but high level players will often have Othersouls that zero out your damage, especially on the first two turns.

If your best gear isn't penetrating their armor, try switching from physical to magic or vice versa, lower defenses with Exploit, or in a pinch, use damage over time like Poison.

author: jon61575
body:
Make sure you’re using fully upgraded weapons and armor on your other souls.

There are three types of enemies at T3, T5, T7 and T9. 

Native players - If they are fully equipped they have an advantage with sub classes, accessories and amities so you might not be able to take them out easily but still possible if you widdle them down over time

Other souls - if you’re using fully upgraded gear you should be able to hit most of them, but some builds can be just as tough as a native player.

AI - Really shouldn’t be a problem with fully upgraded gear.

author: Classic_Power6963
body:
If you're hitting 0 you have to reduce their def or res depending on what type of damage you want to use. Buffs for yourself won't make you get through the armor. There is no other way around. So using reduction spells or applying adornments in your weapons which apply reductions would be key for you.

As someone who owns around 20k crownships I can tell you that all my equipment on the other souls is at least demonforged and I'd assume that counts for most other players as well. In my opinion it's a waste of time trying to wiggle someone down by using statuseffects. (Most of my othersouls hold equipment to reduce or grant immunity to the annoying statuseffects anyway)
